decisions.reason: As a newly launched, highly visible product line closely tied to the firm's core software and digital-practice strategy, management is likely to justify its investment and attribute any early weakness to temporary adoption effects.

Although less central and less prominently committed than core software, the education institute builds on existing customer relationships and recent investment, so management would likely continue it rather than withdraw quickly.

The remote support tool is adjacent to the established service offering and benefits from sunk development and support commitments, but its lower visibility and more peripheral strategic role make it somewhat more droppable than the other launches.
